reference.text: The first part of Mrs. Gardiner’s business, on her arrival, was to distribute her presents and describe the newest fashions.

reference.text: Between the two eldest and herself especially, there subsisted a very particular regard.

reference.text: Mrs. Gardiner, to whom the chief of this news had been given before, in the course of Jane and Elizabeth’s correspondence with her, made her sister a slight answer, and, in compassion to her nieces, turned the conversation.
